key_insight: Complete-muE provides a principled two-bridge parametrization that enables reliable hyperparameter transfer and optimal scaling between dense FFN and any Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) transformer setups, handling both architecture changes and per-expert token load.
problem_solved: Existing transfer tools (e.g., μP, SDE) assume fixed architecture or fixed per-step token counts and therefore fail when moving between dense and MoE models or when changing total experts; Complete-muE solves hyperparameter transfer when both the model architecture and tokens-per-expert change.
method: Two-bridge system: an Architecture Bridge that maps dense-FFN parameterizations to MoE-aware parameterizations, and a Token-Expert Bridge that accounts for changes in per-expert token load when scaling expert count.

Derive scaling and transfer rules that preserve training dynamics across dense↔MoE transitions, producing actionable hyperparameter prescriptions (learning rate, initialization scale, etc.) for any expert-count or token-per-expert regime.
Validate empirically across transformer blocks and MoE configurations to show stable transfer and improved scaling efficiency vs. naive or prior-parametrization approaches.
impact: Enables practitioners to reuse hyperparameters from dense models when moving to or scaling MoE architectures, dramatically reducing costly hyperparameter search and making large-scale MoE training more predictable and efficient.
visual_elements: Two-bridge diagram: show Architecture Bridge and Token-Expert Bridge connecting a dense FFN block to an MoE block with arrows indicating mapped hyperparameters.
Scaling chart: model performance vs. number of experts (and/or tokens-per-expert) comparing Complete-muE vs. baseline transfer rules.
Flowchart recipe: short step-by-step infographic for applying Complete-muE to transfer hyperparameters from a baseline dense model to a target MoE configuration.
Icon set: small icons for 'learning rate', 'init scale', 'expert count', and 'tokens/expert' to highlight which hyperparameters are transferred/adjusted.
paper_title: Complete-muE: Optimal Hyperparameter Transfer and Scaling for MoE Models
paper_authors: Hongwu Peng, Ohiremen Dibua, Yuanjun Xiong, Yifan Gong, Jianming Zhang
